name: review-shots
title: Shot review
description: Any video measured shot by shot as frozen analysis data: where it cuts (hard cuts, dissolves, dips and flashes), how the picture moves (zoom in % a second and pan, labelled push, pull, pan, tilt or static), its levels and its colour, with contact sheets; measured against ground truth. PySceneDetect, TransNet V2 (run in numpy, weights downloaded once) and OpenCV
